title: Spa Chemistry Test Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:chemistry
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by spa_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when spa chemistry test data has stopped arriving for a given spa.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per spa and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your spa chemistry test feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
